summary: Sanity tests are static analysis scripts enforcing Ansible coding standards, run with ansible-test sanity; all run unless --test is given.
questions: How do I run only one sanity test?

answer_card.title: What sanity tests are
answer_card.answer_md: Sanity tests are static code analysis checks that enforce Ansible coding standards. Run them with `ansible-test sanity`. All tests run unless you pick some with `--test`.
